WITH per_status AS (
  SELECT
    CENTROMEA,
    AVG(GOT - GPT) AS avg_ast_minus_alt,
    AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE WBC > 6.5
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ast_minus_alt) AS avg_of_status_ast_minus_alt,
  AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_of_status_aptt_minus_pt
FROM per_status;
